changelog:
- Initial release of the best-image-generation skill (v1.0.2) for high quality AI image creation and editing using the WellAPI gpt-image-2 model.
- Supports both text-to-image and image-to-image (editing) via simple API endpoints.
- Direct synchronous responses with images as base64 (no polling or URL download).
- Output images are automatically named and attached, with robust security for file handling.
- Built-in onboarding: prompts users to paste their API key if not already provided.
- Trigger phrases in both Chinese and English enable fast image generation or editing from natural prompts.
summary: High quality AI image generation via the WellAPI gpt-image-2 model. Supports text-to-image and image editing (image-to-image).
